prompts: A full shot in a hotel-style corridor with warm yellow lighting, worn carpet, and no windows. A thin man, 30-35, with a long narrow face, prominent cheekbones, deep-set eye sockets, messy black short hair, and visible stubble, wearing a faded dark gray crew-neck T-shirt, black trousers, and old white sneakers, with a pale old scar on his left wrist, walks from the deep end of the corridor toward the camera. The camera is low-angle and fixed, slowly pushing forward. He stops, bends down, and reaches for a water bottle on the floor. His fingertips just touch the bottle when it instantly vanishes, leaving only a ring of water stain. He freezes, hand suspended mid-air, looking confused and lost. Landscape 832x480.

A medium shot in a dim, slightly darkened hotel corridor with identical doors on both sides and worn carpet, warm yellow overhead light casting soft shadows. A thin man, 30-35, with a gaunt elongated face, prominent cheekbones, deep-set eye sockets, messy short black hair, visible stubble, wearing a faded dark grey crew-neck T-shirt, black trousers, and old white sneakers, a pale old scar on his left wrist. He gets up from a crouch, wipes his face with one hand, then walks forward. In the distance a water bottle sits on the floor. His eyes widen and he sprints toward it, arm outstretched, but the bottle vanishes with a faint electric flicker just before his fingers reach it. He skids to a stop, chest heaving, breathing hard. Handheld camera follows him forward, slight shake, landscape 832x480.

A lean man with a long thin face, prominent cheekbones, deep-set eye sockets, messy short black hair and visible stubble, wearing a faded dark grey crew-neck T-shirt, black trousers and old white sneakers, sprints at full speed down a dim hotel corridor corner. Low-angle close tracking shot pushes forward as he lunges, his left hand with a pale old scar on the wrist almost touching a clear water bottle on the worn carpet. The bottle evaporates into faint mist right before his fingers reach it. He crashes to his knees, catches himself with both hands on the carpet, head bowed, shoulders heaving, and stays down. Warm yellow overhead lighting, cool shadows, worn patterned carpet, identical doors on both sides, no windows. 832x480 landscape.

A medium shot, slightly low angle, fixed camera. A long, narrow hotel corridor with identical doors on both sides, worn carpet, warm dim yellow light, no windows. A man, 30-35, thin long face, prominent cheekbones, deep-set eyes, messy short black hair, visible stubble, slim build, wearing a washed-out dark grey crew-neck T-shirt, black trousers, old white sneakers, a pale old scar on his left wrist. He slowly rises from a crouch, takes a deep breath, turns and walks toward the nearest door. He grips the handle, pauses one second, pushes the door open. Beyond the door: pitch blackness. The camera stays fixed; the man moves continuously through the frame. Cool, minimal, oppressive mood.

A 30-35 year old man stands at the far end of a long, windowless hotel corridor, facing the camera. He has a thin long face, prominent cheekbones, deep-set eye sockets, messy short black hair, and visible stubble; he is slim, wearing a washed-out dark grey crew-neck T-shirt, black trousers, and old white sneakers, with a pale old scar on his left wrist. The corridor is lined with identical doors, worn carpet, warm yellow ceiling lights. Wide shot, fixed camera at one end looking down the hallway. A door near the man slowly swings shut, and the ceiling lights switch off one by one from near to far, plunging the corridor into total darkness while the man remains motionless.
